import_story.title: SO-MIRROR Gate
import_story.description: Memory World Info mirror: a fresh chat creates its own lorebook through ST's create path, sees it listed without a reload, binds it to the chat, and the entries fire in a real generation.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: true, cadence: 2 }); return true;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const chatId = ctx.getCurrentChatId(); const name = `Story Orchestrator - SO-MIRROR Gate - ${chatId}`; const listed = (ctx.getWorldInfoNames?.() ?? []).includes(name); const onDisk = await fetch('/api/settings/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: '{}' }).then((r) => r.json()).then((s) => (s.world_names ?? []).includes(name)); if (listed || onDisk) throw new Error(`the mirror book already exists: listed=${listed} onDisk=${onDisk}`); if (ctx.chatMetadata.world_info) throw new Error(`the fresh chat already has a chat lorebook: ${ctx.chatMetadata.world_info}`); if (globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook) throw new Error('fresh chat already owns a mirror book'); globalThis.__soMirror = { chatId, name }; globalThis.__soMirrorLog = [{ before: { listed, onDisk, slot: ctx.chatMetadata.world_info ?? null } }]; return globalThis.__soMirror;

steps.send_generate: We step into the moonlit hall. I tell Arin that the brass statue by the stairs is the one from my dream, and he swears to watch my back no matter what.
I ask Arin to guard the statue while I copy the inscription on its base into my journal.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const { chatId, name } = globalThis.__soMirror; if (SillyTavern.getContext().getCurrentChatId() !== chatId) throw new Error('the chat changed under the run'); const audit = { id: 'mirror-scene', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'scene:location', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: 0, to: 4 }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [], sceneBreak: { at: 4, reason: 'location' } }; await rt.runSceneBreakPass(audit); const scenes = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((entry) => entry.tier === 'scene_history'); if (!scenes.length || scenes[0].text.length < 10) throw new Error('expected a real scene summary, got ' + JSON.stringify(scenes)); const out = { scene: scenes[0].text, wiBook: rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook }; (globalThis.__soMirrorLog ??= []).push(out); return out;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const { chatId, name } = globalThis.__soMirror; const wiBook = rt.getSnapshot().memory.wiBook; if (wiBook?.name !== name || wiBook?.chatId !== chatId) throw new Error('the chat did not record its mirror book: ' + JSON.stringify(wiBook)); const worldNames = ctx.getWorldInfoNames(); if (!worldNames.includes(name)) throw new Error('not in world_names without a reload: ' + JSON.stringify(worldNames.filter((n) => n.startsWith('Story Orchestrator')))); const picker = [...document.querySelectorAll('#world_info option')].some((o) => o.textContent === name); const editor = [...document.querySelectorAll('#world_editor_select option')].some((o) => o.textContent === name); if (!picker || !editor) throw new Error(`missing from the pickers: global=${picker} editor=${editor}`); const lorebookNames = rt.getProvisioningEnvironment().lorebookNames; if (!lorebookNames.includes(name)) throw new Error('listAllLorebooks (the lorebookExists source) does not see it'); if (ctx.chatMetadata.world_info !== name) throw new Error('not bound to the chat: ' + ctx.chatMetadata.world_info); const buttonSet = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat_lorebook_button')].every((b) => b.classList.contains('world_set')); const server = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }) }).then((r) => r.json()); const comments = Object.values(server.entries ?? {}).map((e) => e.comment); if (!comments.some((c) => String(c).startsWith('so_'))) throw new Error('the server file holds no mirrored entry: ' + JSON.stringify(comments)); const out = { worldNames: true, picker, editor, lorebookNames: true, bound: ctx.chatMetadata.world_info, buttonSet, serverEntries: comments }; (globalThis.__soMirrorLog ??= []).push(out); return out;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const { name } = globalThis.__soMirror; const mk = (text, entities) => ({ tier: 'facts', type: 'relationship', importance: 2, expiration: 'permanent', entities, text, evidence: 'seed' }); await rt.applyExtractionAudit({ id: 'mirror-seed', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'manual', contractHash: 'h', scope: [], window: { from: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, to: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length }, prompt: 'p', rawResponse: 'r', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [] }, [], [mk('Arin has sworn an oath to guard Max, and keeps a silver bell tied to his belt as its token.', ['Arin'])]); const first = await rt.syncWorldInfo(); if (first.lorebook !== name || first.created < 1 || first.binding !== null) throw new Error('expected one new entry in the owned book, no re-bind: ' + JSON.stringify(first)); const second = await rt.syncWorldInfo(); if (second.created || second.updated || second.disabled || second.binding !== null) throw new Error('a second sync was not a no-op: ' + JSON.stringify(second)); (globalThis.__soMirrorLog ??= []).push({ first, second }); return { first, second };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); globalThis.__soMirrorActivated = []; globalThis.__soMirrorListener = (entries) => { for (const entry of entries ?? []) globalThis.__soMirrorActivated.push({ world: entry.world, comment: entry.comment }); }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.WORLD_INFO_ACTIVATED, globalThis.__soMirrorListener); return true;

steps.send_generate: Arin, is that silver bell still tied to your belt? Ring it if anything moves near the statue.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.WORLD_INFO_ACTIVATED, globalThis.__soMirrorListener); const { name } = globalThis.__soMirror; const fromMirror = globalThis.__soMirrorActivated.filter((entry) => entry.world === name); if (!fromMirror.length) throw new Error('no entry of the mirror book fired in a real generation: ' + JSON.stringify(globalThis.__soMirrorActivated)); (globalThis.__soMirrorLog ??= []).push({ activated: fromMirror }); return { activated: fromMirror };
